_comment: Single source of truth for EC2 pricing used to derive cost-per-token / cost-per-task. The EFFECTIVE hourly rate a run is charged is dollars_per_hour * (1 - discount), further prorated by tp/gpus_per_instance for a partial-box (TP < gpus) run -- see pricing.py resolve(). discount is the FRACTIONAL DISCOUNT off the base: 0.35 = 35% off = pay 65% of dollars_per_hour; 0.0 = pay the full base rate. Update rates here and regenerate the throughput summaries + charts; do not hardcode prices in scripts. `rates` records the alternative price points for reference; `dollars_per_hour` is the base actually used and `_rate_basis` states which point it is.

g6e.12xlarge._rate_basis: 3-year Reserved Instance (RI); discount 0.0 (base already reflects the RI, no further discount)

g6e.4xlarge._rate_basis: 3-year Reserved Instance (RI); discount 0.0 (base already reflects the RI, no further discount). Same basis as g6e.12xlarge, and the same ratios to on-demand (1-yr 63%, 3-yr 43%).

p5en.48xlarge._rate_basis: on-demand base with 0.35 discount (35% off placeholder -> pay 65%), effective 41.1424/hr
